memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: 81‑year‑old man with known NAFLD and B12 deficiency requests review and renewal of medications.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 68 kg, BMI 24.3 (overweight). Abdomen soft, no hepatomegaly.
IMPRESSION: Stable NAFLD, B12 deficiency on replacement.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Order LFT, lipid profile, vitamin B12, CBC, platelet count and abdominal ultrasound. Return if jaundice, dark urine, abdominal pain, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ALT 48 U/L (7‑35), AST 42 U/L (10‑40), ALP 92 U/L (30‑120), GGT 55 U/L (<51). Total bilirubin 1.0 mg/dL (0.2‑1.2). Albumin 4.0 g/dL (3.5‑5.0). INR 1.0. Triglycerides 168 mg/dL (<150). HDL 38 mg/dL (>40). LDL 112 mg/dL (<100). Vitamin B12 210 pg/mL (200‑900). Hemoglobin 13.2 g/dL (13‑17). MCV 92 fL (80‑100). Platelets 210 ×10⁹/L (150‑400).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: Liver size 15 cm, diffuse increased echogenicity suggestive of steatosis. No focal lesion. Portal vein normal. Spleen normal. No ascites. Impression: Consistent with NAFLD, grade 1 steatosis.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up; patient reports good tolerance, no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 67.5 kg, BMI 24.2 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: LFTs improved slightly; LDL still above target.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase rosuvastatin to 10 mg OD to improve lipid control. Continue silymarin and methylcobalamin. Repeat LFT, lipid profile, vitamin B12, CBC in 3 months. Return if muscle pain, weakness, dark urine, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review; patient feels well.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/80 mmHg, weight 67 kg, BMI 23.9 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: LDL now at goal; liver enzymes stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Maintain current meds. Order LFT, lipid profile, vitamin B12, CBC, platelet count. Return if jaundice, abdominal swelling, fever >39°C, or unexplained bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mild fatigue noted over past week.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/78 mmHg, weight 66.8 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Fatigue possibly related to borderline B12; hemoglobin normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Check vitamin B12 level; continue silymarin, rosuvastatin, methylcobalamin. Order LFT, lipid profile, vitamin B12, CBC. Return if worsening fatigue, dyspnea, chest pain, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ALT 45 U/L, AST 39 U/L, ALP 89 U/L, GGT 51 U/L. Triglycerides 150 mg/dL, HDL 40 mg/dL, LDL 90 mg/dL. Vitamin B12 190 pg/mL (low). Hemoglobin 13.3 g/dL, MCV 95 fL (slightly high), Platelets 198 ×10⁹/L.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up after B12 adjustment; fatigue improved.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/76 mmHg, weight 66.5 kg, BMI 23.7 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: B12 now adequate; liver stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg BID. Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar as annual review. Return if polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Annual review; patient asymptomatic.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/74 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 23.5 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: All parameters within target; NAFLD stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. No new labs needed today. Return if jaundice, abdominal pain, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Final review before year end; patient reports feeling well.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/72 mmHg, weight 65.8 kg, BMI 23.4 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: NAFLD and B12 deficiency well controlled.
ARRANGEMENTS: Advise to maintain medication regimen and lifestyle. Return if new jaundice, unexplained weight loss, fever >39°C, or bleeding.
